verdict.rationale: Instinct is a personal AI agent that acts across connected apps such as Gmail, Sheets and Drive. Early testers reported it handling inherently multi-item work like "cleaning up inboxes", CRM management and batches of booking follow-ups, which implies bulk actions. However, the vendor never describes a bulk-operation capability, and no tester details how many items were handled at once or how reliably. missing for 10: first-party documentation of batch or bulk actions, hands-on evidence of operating on many items in a single request, limits or confirmation controls for mass changes.
